title: 3EN002 + Pi-hole read-only network audit
description: Read-only diagnostics from Windows 11. Check reachability of OpenWrt router 3EN002 at 192.168.1.2, selected TCP ports, active IPv4 DNS servers, DNS resolution through the configured resolver, and pi.hole resolution. No router, Pi-hole, firewall, DNS, or Windows configuration is changed.
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; $Report='C:\3EN-Agent\network-audit-008.txt'; $lines=[System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new(); function Add([string]$s){$lines.Add($s);Write-Host $s}; Add '=== 3EN NETWORK AUDIT 008 ==='; Add ('Time: '+(Get-Date -Format o)); Add ''; Add '--- ROUTER 3EN002 / 192.168.1.2 ---'; $ping=Test-Connection -ComputerName '192.168.1.2' -Count 2 -Quiet -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Add ('PING=' + $ping); foreach($p in 22,53,80,443){$t=Test-NetConnection -ComputerName '192.168.1.2' -Port $p -WarningAction SilentlyContinue; Add ('TCP_'+$p+'=' + $t.TcpTestSucceeded)}; Add ''; Add '--- WINDOWS ACTIVE DNS ---'; $dns=(Get-DnsClientServerAddress -AddressFamily IPv4 | Where-Object {$_.ServerAddresses.Count -gt 0} | ForEach-Object {$_.ServerAddresses} | Sort-Object -Unique); if($dns){foreach($d in $dns){Add ('DNS_SERVER='+$d)}}else{Add 'DNS_SERVER=NONE'}; Add ''; Add '--- DNS RESOLUTION ---'; try{$r=Resolve-DnsName 'google.com' -Type A -DnsOnly -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object {$_.IPAddress} | Select-Object -First 3 -ExpandProperty IPAddress; Add ('GOOGLE_A=' + ($r -join ','))}catch{Add ('GOOGLE_A=FAIL '+$_.Exception.Message)}; try{$pih=Resolve-DnsName 'pi.hole' -Type A -DnsOnly -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object {$_.IPAddress} | Select-Object -First 3 -ExpandProperty IPAddress; Add ('PIHOLE_A=' + ($pih -join ','))}catch{Add ('PIHOLE_A=FAIL '+$_.Exception.Message)}; Add ''; Add '--- DEFAULT ROUTE ---'; $gw=Get-NetRoute -DestinationPrefix '0.0.0.0/0' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object RouteMetric | Select-Object -First 1; if($gw){Add ('DEFAULT_GATEWAY='+$gw.NextHop);Add ('INTERFACE_INDEX='+$gw.InterfaceIndex)}else{Add 'DEFAULT_GATEWAY=NONE'}; $lines | Set-Content -LiteralPath $Report -Encoding UTF8; Add ''; Add ('REPORT='+$Report)
test: $Report='C:\3EN-Agent\network-audit-008.txt'; if(-not(Test-Path $Report)){throw 'Audit report missing.'}; $c=Get-Content $Report -Raw; foreach($marker in @('PING=','DNS_SERVER=','GOOGLE_A=','DEFAULT_GATEWAY=')){if($c -notmatch [regex]::Escape($marker)){throw ('Missing audit marker: '+$marker)}}; Write-Host 'NETWORK AUDIT COLLECTION PASS'; Get-Content $Report
